title: CalendarRangePicker: add a new scrollable multi-month calendar to pick a date range visually, with coloured day marks, a collapsible legend and a shortcut back to today
description: Days can be marked by half, morning and afternoon carrying their own colour, so a day shared between two records stays readable. Days that cannot be picked are shown as a round badge above the marks and can carry their own colour to tell several kinds apart. Pressing a day that already holds records opens a sheet listing them, from which the free half of the day can still be taken, and a range is shortened so that it never spans a day that is already full.
